subject: POC plan & model selection for Finova - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@finova.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: POC plan & model selection for Finova - next steps

Hi Carlos —

Thanks again for the productive discovery call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned for the POC/trial: 

Summary of needs (from call)
- Use-case: contextual customer support assistant + routing for banking products (KYC questions, transaction inquiries)
- Volume: ~1M API tokens/month during trial peak
- SLA: 95th percentile latency target ~300ms for short-form generative answers; batch jobs for async summarization ok
- Data & compliance: SOC 2 required, prefer VPC for production later
- Multilingual: English primary, Spanish + Portuguese support (translation pipeline acceptable)

Proposed POC acceptance criteria (we can refine):
1) Latency: 95p < 350ms on Redwood Dedicated config with our suggested batching
2) Quality: OOTB generative accuracy on 100-case eval > 85% (semantic correctness) and entity extraction F1 > 0.8
3) Cost: unit cost < $X per 1k tokens (we'll propose targets once we pick model/quantization)
4) Integration: simple API end-to-end demo + data access pattern agreed

Model selection (initial recommendation)
- Primary: Llama-2-13B-chat (balanced quality / cost for conversational assistant)
- Fallback / low-latency: Mistral-7B (quantized int8) for peaky traffic and routing failsafe
- For long-form/heavy context paths: consider Llama-2-70B-chat in Dedicated if quality gaps appear (we can propose a cost/latency tradeoff)

Multilingual approach
- Option A (preferred): single-model approach if primary model performs adequately in ES/PT on our eval set
- Option B: EN -> translate pipeline (send to MT service pre/post) for highest quality in early POC

Ownership & timeline (proposed)
- Redwood setup (Aditya): spin up Dedicated trial environment + model routing (ETA 3 business days after signed MSA)
- Customer integration (Aisha/Carlos): provide test dataset + access pattern by 2026-08-21
- CS/Success (Neha): define evaluation suite and golden prompts by 2026-08-22
- Demo + sync: target demo of baseline model on 2026-08-24

Attachments: POC-MAP.xlsx (proposed success criteria matrix) and SOC2-overview.pdf (high-level) attached.

Next steps: Can you confirm the success criteria above and that the timeline works? If yes we’ll prepare a short SOW and get Aditya started on the infra side.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

From: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@finova.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC plan & model selection for Finova - next steps

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. A few clarifications: 

1) Success criteria: the quality line items look right. For the generative accuracy test, can we define the 100-case eval together? We have a mix of legal/regulatory phrasing that is sensitive.
2) Multilingual: Spanish is critical (~20% traffic) and Portuguese is smaller (~5%). If Llama-2-13B has a significant gap we’ll prefer the translation pipeline to avoid risk.
3) Timeline: August 24 demo is fine but we need the environment accessible by Aisha (integration lead) at least 48 hours before to validate connectivity.
4) Security: SOC2 overview appreciated — we will share our security questionnaire. If Redwood can provide an MSA template with standard PII clauses that speeds us up.

Also looping in Aisha to confirm dataset delivery timing.

—Carlos
Head of Product, Finova
c.mendes@finova.com

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Mendes <c.mendes@finova.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC plan & model selection for Finova - next steps

Hi Carlos —

Quick notes from the infra side:
- I can provision a Dedicated trial cluster with Llama-2-13B-chat and Mistral-7B quantized images. ETA for infra: ~48 hours once we have a signed trial SOW and access bits.
- Routing plan: primary -> Llama13B; fallback -> mistral7b-int8 when queue latency or memory pressure triggers. We’ll instrument percent-fallback metrics.
- For Spanish/Portuguese: I suggest we run a quick 200-sample bilingual eval set (we can help build this) to see if single-model is acceptable. If not, we’ll add translate pre/post steps as an interim.
- Attachments: I’ll add a short runbook doc to the Drive folder for the handoff.

I’ll start the cluster once we have the SOW. If Marissa can push the SOW and Aisha can confirm dataset delivery timeline, I’ll prioritize setup.

Cheers,
Aditya
